Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh once again proved to be toothless. The wicket was suitable for batting, yes, but during the lack of wickets, there was a failure to apply pressure and clog the runs up. Boundaries came freely and they paid the price for it. It was only for a brief period towards the end when the ball started reversing a bit that we saw them reap some rewards. Now, they face their most difficult task yet on this tour. The ball will grip and turn more and there will be more reverse on offer for the bowlers. The top order will be key for the visitors to get something here today. Join us in a while for the chase.

A strong finish to the innings has seen South Africa put up a mountain of a total on the board. After the way their openers set it all up with a century stand, and then Faf and Markram continuing in the same fashion, the 400-mark was well within their sights. But then, a double blow in quick time, which included an injury to the skipper and Markram's run out saw the Proteas stumble a bit. However, a late impetus from Behardien and Rabada saw South Africa cross 350 and put them in a dominating position.

FOUR! Finishes the innings off with a boundary! Fuller in length by Rubel on middle, Behardien heaves it over mid-wicket and finds the fence. A very good last over, 18 from it. SOUTH AFRICA FINISH ON A MAMMOTH 369 for 6.
Fuller in length outside off, Farhaan drives it square through the off side for a couple.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! What a cameo this is turning out to be! This time through the off side. Rubel serves another gift, a full toss outside off. Kagiso strokes it past the diving cover fielder for a boundary.
SIX! Young KG is on the charge here! A full toss on middle, Rabada walks across and helps it over the fine leg fence for a maximum. Rubel was looking for a yorker but missed his length by a meter.
Fuller in length on middle, the batsman strokes it through covers for a run.
FOUR! He had some swag about that shot! Fuller in length outside off, by Taskin! Rabada goes inside out over covers for a boundary. Second of the over, a good one for South Africa. 350 up now.
Very full on leg stump, Farhaan drives it down to long on for a run. Bangladesh won't mind these singles.
In the air... but safe! Slower ball by Taskin on leg stump, Rabada tries to flick but closes the face early. He gets a leading edge and it goes on the bounce to the long on fielder for a run.
FOUR! SHOT! Short and on middle by Taskin! Rabada takes on the challenge of pulling it and does well. He times it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Very full outside off, Rabada misses the drive and it goes through to the keeper.
Fuller in length on middle, Behardien digs it out to mid-wicket for a run.
A yorker again on off, Farhaan plays it towards covers for a run.
Fuller in length outside off, Kagiso drives it through covers for a run.
A brilliant yorker has Rabada down on the ground! A yorker on leg stump, Rabada misses the flick. The ball hits him flush on the boots. Very good bowling.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shorter in length on middle, Rabada pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller in length on off, the batsman drives it towards mid off for a run.
Kagiso Rabada is the new batsman.

OUT! Second in the over for Taskin! South Africa are losing their way a little now! Fuller in length by Taskin, swinging away. Phehlukwayo tries to force it down the ground but gets an edge to the keeper who takes it. The players appeal and the umpire signals it out. Bangladesh are finishing the innings off well here.
A yorker on leg stump. All Behardien can do is dig it out towards long on for a run.
A full toss outside off, Andile gets it off the outside edge down to third man for a run.
Fuller in length outside off, Andile drives it to the man at covers.
FOUR! He needs no sighters! Taskin errs in line and drifts it on the pads. Phehlukwayo flicks it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Andile Phehlukwayo is the next man in.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Taskin bowls it fuller in length on middle, Mulder goes for the flick but misses and gets struck on the pads. The Bangladeshi players appeal and the umpire raises his finger immediately. Not a good outing with the bat for the debutant as he departs early. A good period for Bangladesh.
Fuller in length on off, Mulder drives it through mid on for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shorter in length on middle, Farhaan pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. One run added to the total.
Fuller in length on off, Farhaan drives it through covers for a run.
Willem Mulder strides out to the middle. Also we are getting word from the dressing room that Faf du Plessis won't be featuring in this game.

OUT! A huge, huge wicket courtesy a brilliant catch by the skipper! Mashrafe leading from the front. The big fish AB de Villiers is walking back. He did not have the same impact as the last game. A slower full ball outside off by Rubel. The batsman tries to go over covers but miscues it towards the cover fielder. Mortaza there did not look comfortable under it, but he dived to his left, got two hands to it and clung on. Bangladesh will now look to restrict South Africa to something under 360.

FOUR! He is persisting with the shorter stuff but it is only resulting in runs! Bouncer again on the body of the batsman, comes at a good height. Behardien pulls it through backward square leg for boundary.
FOUR! One short ball too many! Too easy for Behardien! Taskin bangs it in short and outside off, sits up to be hit. Farhaan slaps it over covers for a boundary.
Shortish ball outside off, Farhaan tries to drag his pull through the leg side but gets beaten.
Fullish ball outside off, the batsman drives it through point for a run.
A very well bowled yorker. De Villiers digs it out towards mid-wicket and some excellent running helps them take two.
Fuller in length on off, AB mistimes his drive back to the bowler.
Taskin Ahmed is back into the attack.
Exposes all his stumps even before the bowler has delivered. Such is his confidence. Rubel bowls it full and outside off, AB reaches out and forces it through covers for one. Retains strike.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Behardien goes on his back foot and steers it through point for a single.
FOUR! Quality shot! A low full toss outside off, Farhaan leans into the shot and drives it crisply through covers for a boundary.

Appeal for an lbw! Fuller in length on middle, angling down, Behardien fails to flick and is hit on the pads. The bowler appeals as the batsmen cross for a couple of runs. It's given as leg byes and now Bangladesh opt for the DRS. Missing leg is the verdict from the Hawk Eye! Waste of a review.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Flicks it with the angle towards wide long on for a run.

SIX! BOOM! Beautiful, he makes it look so easy. Fuller in length outside off, AB de Villiers lofts it over covers for a maximum. A wonderful way to finish the over and it also brings up the 300 for South Africa.
Fuller in length on off, Farhaan drives it down to long off for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Good length on off, the batsman guides it to point.
Fuller in length on off, the batsman drives it to the man at covers.
Angles it on the pads, Behardien works it around the corner for an easy two.
Fullish length ball outside off, AB eases it through covers for a couple. The fielder in the deep fumbles which makes the second run easier.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Fuller in length on off, AB lofts it over covers for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bowls it on the pads, Farhaan flicks it through the leg side to change strike.
Works it with the angle through mid-wicket for a run.
Farhaan Behardien is the next man in.

OUT! The direct hit has done the job this time! Markram is short of his crease, even the dive does not save him. An unwanted second to be honest. A slower ball on middle, Aiden works it towards square leg and completes a run. He sets off for a second. Imrul Kayes in the deep is quick to the ball and scores a direct hit at the keeper's end. The players appeal and the umpire goes upstairs. Replays show that the batsman is well short of his crease. A good debut innings by Markram comes to an end. He will be disappointed with himself for getting out in that fashion, got out similarly on his Test debut as well (that was more heartbreaking as he was on 97 then). For Bangladesh, they now have two new batsmen at the crease. Just what they wanted.
A direct hit is always close and Markram might just be struggling to make his ground here. An appeal for a run out at the striker's end has been taken upstairs.
Flicks it with the angle through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Off the mark with a boundary! Two balls are all he needed to get his eye in. De Villiers comes down the track and hits it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Back of a length on off, the batsman defends it towards covers.
Good length on off, AB drives it back to the bowler.
Ab de Villiers strides out to the middle.

Oh no! The physio is out to attend du Plessis who might have done some damage to his lower back as he is seen holding that part. He is on 91 and he also can't have a runner. So he is limping off, it might be something really serious. In fact, David Miller is now carrying him on his back, climbing the stairs and taking him all the way to the dressing room. Get well soon, Faf!

Slower ball on middle, Faf flicks it towards mid-wicket and they complete a run. He wants a second. The fielder is quick to the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. Had he hit Markram would have been a goner. Du Plessis seems to have hurt his lower back while turning for the second run. He is holding that part and goes down flat at the non-striker's end. He is screaming in pain. Not looking good.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Now, a maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring. Also, Mashrafe Mortaza is back into the attack.
Shorter in length around middle, du Plessis pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Sprays it on the pads, Aiden misses the flick to get struck on the pads. There is an ambitious appeal from the bowler but the umpire stays put. The batsmen take a leg bye. Missing leg.
A brilliant yorker on off, Faf digs it out towards covers for a run.
Slower ball outside off, the batsman makes room and also comes down the track. He goes after the ball but gets beaten.
Fuller in length around off, du Plessis drives it to covers.
FOUR! Exquisite! Fuller in length on off, Faf drives it straight down the ground for a boundary. He is in ruthless form.
Rubel Hossain is into the attack.
Pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Slows it up on off stump. Markram comes down the track but does not quite get to the pitch of the ball. He continues with the shot but gets a bottom edge down towards short fine leg for a run.
Flatter on off, Markram shuffles across and sweeps it towards deep square leg. It does not quite hit the middle but still enough to get two.
Fires it in on leg stump, Faf works it towards mid-wicket for a quick run.
Shorter in length around off, Markram cuts it through covers for a run.
Comes down the track and drives it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Drilled! Faf comes down the track and gets to the pitch of the ball. He smashes it down to the long on fence for a boundary. South Africa are on the charge here.
Angles it on the pads, Faf flicks it through the leg side for two.

FOUR! A brilliant effort by the fielder in the deep but to no avail! A poor line and it has been dispatched! Short and wide outside off, Faf cuts it through point. The fielder in the deep runs fast to his left, puts in a dive, tries to push the ball back in but is unable to do so. Another boundary for South Africa.
Shorter in length, does not bounce that much. Markram pulls it through square leg for a run.
Length ball on middle, angling into the batsman. Markram flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Good length on off, the batsman taps it towards covers for a run.
Taskin Ahmed is into the attack.
FOUR! STREAKY! Flatter and quicker outside off, Markram tries to cut but gets an outside edge through the vacant first slip region for a boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Dances down the track and drives it down to long on for a run.
Plays it with the angle through mid-wicket for a run.

NOT OUT! Faf punches the short ball through covers and completes a run. He sets off for a second. The fielder is quick to the ball and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end. The players appeal and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replays show Aiden has made his crease quite comfortably.
A run out appeal has been taken upstairs at the non-striker's end against Aiden Markram. Direct hits are always close but the fielders don't look excited.
Shorter in length outside off, Aiden punches it through the off side for a run.
Shakib Al Hasan is into the attack.
Drinks!

FOUR! Save your legs, Mortaza! Faf comes down the track to the length ball and slaps it past the bowler for a boundary. That went to the fence like a tracer bullet. 15 runs from the over. South Africa are on the charge here.
An off cutter fuller in length on off, Aiden drives it through covers for a run.
This time he punches it through the off side for an easy single.
FOUR! And again! A touch fuller this time by Mortaza. Faf goes down on one knee and paddles this one over short fine leg for another boundary. Back-to-back boundaries for the skipper.
FOUR! Improvisation at its best by Faf! Mashrafe lands it on a length around off, du Plessis paddle scoops it over short fine leg and into the fence for a boundary.
Fuller in length on off, Markram drives it through mid on for a run.
Maiden ODI fifty for Markram! He's picked up from where he left off in the Test series. He punches it on the off side and takes a single.
FOUR! Finds the gap to perfection! Knowing there is no one square in the deep on the off side, Aiden Markram backs away to the ball outside off and cuts it through cover-point for a boundary.
Slower through the air on off, Faf drives it down to long on to change strike.
Pushes it to the man at covers.
Works it with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
From around the wicket, angles it across the batsman on a shorter length. Du Plessis, off the back foot, punches it to the man at covers.
Walks across the stumps and drags it through mid-wicket for a run.
Shorter in length on middle, Aiden pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Good length on off, Markram drives it on the up and on the bounce to the fielder at mid off.
29th ODI fifty for the skipper! A breezy knock by him. He would want to make it big now. Length ball on off, Faf taps it towards covers for a run.

FOUR! How has that gone for a boundary? Mashrafe can't believe it. He sees Faf walking across and bowls a slower one outside off. Du Plessis continues with his shot and gets it off the inner half through square leg for a boundary.
Back of a length on off, Markram punches it through the off side for a run.
Fuller in length outside off, the spin is out of question, that is how full the ball was. Faf lunges forward and drives it through covers to bag a brace.
Floats it up on off, turning back into the batsman. Aiden plants his front foot forward and flicks it through mid on for a run.
Slower through the air on middle, Faf waits for it and flicks it through square leg to change strike.
Flicks it with the spin through mid on for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Markram drives it back to the bowler.
Flatter outside off, Aiden guides it to point.
Mehedi Hasan is into the attack.
FOUR! The last ball ruins the over! Fuller in length by Mortaza on off, Faf walks across and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Great wrist work! Good length on off, Aiden whips it through mid-wicket to change strike.
Flicks it with the angle through mid-wicket for a run.

Good length on off, du Plessis taps it towards cover and sets off for a run. The fielder scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end but the batsman has made his crease. The ball deflects past the fielder backing up to give South Africa an extra run.
Back of a length on off, Faf punches it to the man at covers.
Mashrafe Mortaza who is into the attack bowls it on a length on off, Faf drives it on the up to the man at covers.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
FOUR! The part-time bowlers are just giving away a lot of runs! Short and wide outside off, too easy for Aiden as he cuts it through point for a boundary. These two are moving along well here.
Too easy! On the pads of the batsman, he flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller outside off, Aiden eases it through covers to change strike.
Tosses it up on middle, Faf times it down to long on for a single.
Fires it on middle, the batsman drives it down to long on for a run.
Sabbir Rahman comes onto bowl.

FOUR! Not convincing but du Plessis won't mind. He makes room and flashes hard at the full ball outside off. The ball goes off the outside edge down to the third man fence for another boundary. 17 runs from the over. The move to bring on Mahmudullah has not paid off.
Fires it on the pads, Faf flicks it through square leg and some good running by the batsmen help them take two.
Drives it down through mid on for a run.

FOUR! Through the off side this time! Short again and width on offer. Aiden goes on the back foot and cuts it through covers for a boundary. This also brings up the 50-run stand between the two in no time.
SIX! A hit me ball! Short and it sits up to be hit! Markram rocks back and pulls it powerfully over the mid-wicket fence.
Flatter on middle, Aiden pushes it to mid-wicket.
Floats it up on off, Faf defends it towards point.
Markram uses his feet this time and he flicks it through square leg to change strike.
Comes down the track and drives it down to long on for a run.
Flicks it with the angle through mid-wicket for a run.
Shorter in length and outside off, the batsman cuts it through point for a run.
Du Plessis advances down the track and eases it to the man at covers.
Short on middle, Faf pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run. A better second over by Mahmudullah.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
WIDE! Sprays it down the leg side and the umpire signals a wide.
Dances down the track and drives it through mid on for a run.
Good stop, Taskin! Shorter in length around off, Markram cuts it towards point where the fielder dives to his right and makes a good stop.
Works it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Flatter on off, Markram paddle sweeps it through short fine leg for a couple.
Slower through the air on off, Aiden drives it through covers to keep strike.
Driven through mid off for a run.
CLOSE! That was nicely bowled by Shakib! He bowls it quicker and also drags his length back on middle. Aiden goes on the back foot to cut but then adjusts and guides it through point for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Faf drives it through covers for an easy single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter in length on off, Markram punches it through covers for a run.
SIX! This is even better! Mahmudullah once again gives it air on off, du Plessis goes down on one knee and sweeps it uppishly and over the square leg boundary. Not a good first over by Mahmudullah.
Fuller in length on middle, straightens after pitching. Faf gets a soft leading edge back to the bowler as he tries to flick it.
FOUR! Nails the sweep to perfection! Mahmudullah tosses it up on off, du Plessis goes down on one knee and sweeps it hard through square leg for a boundary.
He gets some turn there! Loopy ball on off, turning into the batsman. Faf tries to defend but gets it off the inner half to the man at square leg.
Flatter on off, Faf defends it off the front foot.
Drags his length back on off, Markram guides it towards point for a run.
Mahmudullah is into the attack.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Floats it on off, the batsman defends it to covers.
Seeing Markram coming down the track, Hasan slows it up. Aiden adjusts and defends it to covers.
WIDE! Fires it down the leg side, Markram lets it be and the umpire signals a wide.
Bowls a round-arm action delivery on middle. Faf with the angle flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Gives it a nice loop and on off, Aiden drives it down to long off for a run.
Loopy ball on off, goes on with the arm. Markram defends it off the front foot.
Slower through the air on off, Markram drives it down to long on for a run.
Flicks it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Very full, almost a yorker. Markram hits it back to the bowler. There is a strange appeal from the keeper but the umpire remains put. He must have felt it might have hit the pad first.
Flatter on off, Markram defends it off the back foot.
SIX! BANG! Excellent use of the feet by the youngster! He sees Mehedi giving air to the delivery. Aiden gets to the pitch of it and effortlessly deposits it over long on for a maximum.
Tosses it up on off, Markram defends it off the front foot.
Short ball outside off, Aiden punches it through the covers for a run.
Floats it full on off, Markram defends it off the front foot.
Works it through mid-wicket against the spin for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drags his length back, Markram punches it through the off side for a run.
Loopy ball on off, Markram defends it solidly.
Loopy ball turning into the batsman. Markram flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. One run added to the total.
First ODI runs for Markram! Works it with the spin through mid-wicket for a run to get off the mark.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Driven towards long on for a run.
Aiden Markram, the debutant, is the next man in. He had a dream Test debut recently. Will he do the same in coloured clothing?

OUT! Mehedi gets his second! The dangerman de Kock is walking back. A very, very good phase of play for Bangladesh. Mehedi bowls it slower through the air again, around off, turning away. De Kock dances down the track and tries to flick but is undone by the flight as he gets a top edge which lobs towards Hasan. He positions himself under it and takes it comfortably. A free flowing knock by de Kock comes to an end. The Bangladeshis are pumped. Two quick wickets for them.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Advances down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller outside off, Faf drives it through covers for a run.
The batsman drives the ball straight down and back to the bowler.
WIDE! Errs in line and fires it down the leg side for a wide.
Plays it with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy ball outside off, du Plessis drives it through covers for a run.

NOT OUT! De Kock survives! A direct hit was needed there. Faf drives the full ball on off towards covers and sets off for a run. The fielder there is quick to the ball and fires a throw to the keeper who collects and whips the bails off. The players appeal and the umpire goes upstairs. Replays show that the dive there has saved de Kock.
An appeal for a run out has been taken upstairs against de Kock at the striker's end. The Bangladesh players don't look that confident.

A huge appeal but nothing from the umpire! Mehedi bowls it slower through the air and gets it to turn into the batsman. Faf tries to work it on the leg side but it goes off the pads and lobs towards the keeper who takes it.
Fuller in length outside off, de Kock drives it to sweeper cover for a run.
Loopy ball outside off, very full so the turn is out of question. Faf gets his front leg towards the ball and drives it through covers for a run.
Straighter one on off, comes in with the angle. De Kock guides it towards point for a run.
Tosses it up on middle, turning into the batsman. Faf flicks it through square leg to rotate strike.
Flicks it with the spin to mid-wicket. A good over, just three from it.
Advances down the track and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Loopy ball on middle, Faf drives it down to long on for a run.
Floats it up on off, du Plessis drives it towards cover where the fielder makes a good diving stop to his right.
Tosses it up on off, Faf defends it off the front foot.
Flicks it with the angle through mid-wicket for a couple.
Shakib Al Hasan is into the attack.
Shorter in length outside off, de Kock cuts it through covers for a run.
Faf du Plessis strides out to the middle.

OUT! Bavuma falls two runs short of his fifty! A needless way of getting out. He was playing so well. Mehedi tosses it up on leg stump, it turns ever so slightly into the batsman. Bavuma gets to the pitch of it and tries to go big but miscues it down to long on. Das pouches it safely by going down low. The 119-run stand comes to an end. Can Bangladesh build on this now?
Comes down the track. Hasan sees it and drags his length back. De Kock adjusts and taps it towards covers for a run.
Drives it with the spin through mid on for a run.
Short around off, turning away. De Kock goes on the back foot and cuts it through covers for a run.
Flatter on the stumps, de Kock pushes it to the man at cover.

Drinks break! A much-needed one for Bangladesh. They're being taken to the cleaners by this opening pair of de Kock and Bavuma. The visitors need a wicket and they need it quick, otherwise they run the risk of facing a humongous total.
Length delivery around off, defended out from inside the crease.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bouncer on the stumps, pulled along the ground to deep square leg for a double.
Angling back in on middle and leg, worked away with the angle on the on side for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Bavuma punches it past the bowler and takes a quick single, beating mid on who gets to the ball quickly and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
Just ahead of a length on middle and off, Temba is solid in defense.

EDGY FOUR! Mehedi a bit unlucky there, a slip in place and that would have been a wicket. After a series of slower delivery, he puts some pace on this one. De Kock looks to drive and gets an edge which goes past the keeper and away to the third man fence.
Easy single. Down the ground to long on and the batsmen cross over.
Dropped short and de Kock charges out. It comes at him slower than expected so he has to adjust and make do with a single through the covers.
Spinning in on middle and leg, Bavuma flicks it off his pads through square leg for one.
Coming back into the batsman, he works it pleasantly through mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls it slower through the air and outside off, Quinton with a solid front foot defense.
Shorter in length which is pulled away towards fine leg for a run.
Fuller in length outside off, eased down to mid off for nothing.

FOUR! As if the runs weren't coming easily enough for South Africa, that Bangladesh decide to gift them more runs. De Kock taps this to point, there's an unnecessary shy at the bowler's end and the ball ricochets off the stumps and races away to the mid-wicket boundary. This is poor stuff from the visitors. The 100-run stand is up with this as well.

FOUR! Bang goes Quinton de Kock! Quality shot, he's such a delight to watch when he plays like this. So elegant and fluent. Full and right in the slot, he lofts it beautifully over mid off and picks up a boundary.
Short of a good length outside off, Temba stands tall and punches it through covers for one.
Fuller ball outside off, sliced through the cover region for a single.
Rubel Hossain back on.

15th ODI fifty for Quinton de Kock! The man is on a roll, the runs keep coming for him. He's such a vital cog in the South African unit, in all formats of the game. Superb stuff. Drives this full ball to long off and reaches the milestone with ease. Set for another big hundred?
Nicely done. Closes the face and works it through mid-wicket for an easy run.
On a flatter trajectory outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter and quicker outside off, pushed into the covers.
Slider from around the wicket, defended from deep inside the crease.
Bumper to end the over, it's ducked and evaded easily.

Fantastic effort! Full toss on the pads, Bavuma flicks it through backward square leg. Seems it'll go all the way, given the quick outfield, and it almost does too, but Imrul Kayes does well to run across to his left from fine leg and stop it with a dive. Mahmudullah backs him up and throws it back in. The umpire wants to make sure if the stop is clean and replays show that it is. Great effort, keeps the batsmen down to just two.
FOUR! The little man packs a real punch! What a hit! Expecting the fuller ball Bavuma shimmies down the track and just hammers this back over the bowler's head for a rocketing boundary.
Wide! Short again but down the leg side this time, Bavuma looks to pull but misses.
Short ball into the body, pulled down to fine leg for one run.
Takes the fielder on again as Bavuma drives it to mid on. This time the run is completed more easily as the fielder doesn't collect the ball cleanly on the first attempt.

Chance of a run out! Length ball around off, Quinton taps it in front of backward point and both batsmen set off. Risky stuff though as the fielder quickly charges to the ball and under arms it at the striker's end diving forward. He misses, much to Bavuma's delight, who was struggling to get back in. Maybe the fielder should have gone at the other end as de Kock was late in taking off.
Turning away from around off, de Kock goes back, allows the ball to turn and places it square towards point for a single.
Full ball attacking the stumps, driven down the track where the fielder misfields. A single results.
Over the wicket now, it's full on middle and off, Bavuma leans across a touch and wrists it to mid on.
Sliding in on middle and leg, de Kock works it square on the leg side and crosses over.
Switches the angle for de Kock, comes around the wicket and tosses it up outside off. The southpaw gets close to the pitch with a big lunge forward and eases it to the man at cover.
Full and flat outside off, no spin on this occasion as Bavuma drives it to sweeper cover. One run added to the scoreboard.
Mehedi Hasan comes back on to bowl.

Was in no control of that shot at all, but such is his day that anything he hits is going away. Short ball outside off, de Kock looks to pull but the ball goes off the high part of the bat and lobs over Taskin's head. Falls safely as mid on chases it down. Two runs to the total.
Short of a good length outside off, pushed away from the back foot on the off side.
Straighter in line, it's tucked off the pads a bit square on the leg side for one.

Back of a length, from over the wicket to Bavuma, another pull shot from the little man through mid-wicket. Would have gone all the way but the fielder in the deep does well to cut it off. A couple of runs are taken.
From around the wicket to de Kock, it's angling into him from a length and he too pulls it through the gap in the leg side for a run.
Shortish ball on off, Temba brings out the pull shot and hits it through mid-wicket aerially for a single.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. Maximum of four fielders are now allowed outside the circle. Bangladesh are using one less at the moment as Taskin steams in...
Quicker and flatter around off, Bavuma with a little shimmy down the track knocks it to long off to keep strike.
Bit quicker through the air, on middle and off, stays right behind the line and defends.
Use of the feet to get close to the pitch and it's driven down to long on for one.

Awkward, but effective. Temba Bavuma kneels down and across to this full ball and plays a funny-looking paddle sweep towards short fine leg. Rubel Hossain stops the ball from going past him with a solid dive. Just a single taken.
Brings his wrists into play and works it just wide of the mid on fielder for a single.

SIX! Quinton de Kock is having a ball out there. From over the wicket, it's loopy, full and right in de Kock's zone. He dances down quickly and smokes it back over the bowler's head for a huge maximum.
Short and wide outside off, cut square through point for a single.
Length delivery on the fourth stump line, defended out from within the crease.
Back of a good length outside off from around the wicket, punched hard but straight to the cover fielder.

FOUR! As beautiful as the sunshine over at Buffalo Park. Magnificent stroke. Half-volley outside off, Quinton de Kock with a scintillating drive straight back down the ground. No chance for anybody to stop that, the fast outfield takes it all the way to the boundary.
Fuller length ball outside off, driven through the covers for a brace.

Length delivery around off, cramping de Kock for room and it almost does the trick. He looks to force it through the off side but gets an inside edge past the leg stump. Need more of this from the Bangladesh bowlers.
Taskin Ahmed is into the attack now.

FOUR! A potential good over ruined because of a boundary on the last delivery. Full on the stumps, bit straighter in line which allows Bavuma to flick it well through the mid-wicket area. Right in the gap and it's away to the fence in a flash. 50-run stand up, great going for South Africa!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Straighter one on middle and off, Bavuma stays behind the line and blocks.
Comfortably done. De Kock leans forward and eases this full ball down towards mid on for a single.
Tossed up on middle stump, flicked away through mid-wicket for a run.

Shakib into the action and there's drama instantly. Floats it up on middle and leg, it's angling in and catches Bavuma on the front pad as he misses his flick. Loud appeal all around, but the umpire remains unmoved. Good decision, replays show it was going down leg. Close call, though.
Bangladesh's star player, Shakib Al Hasan to roll his arm now. A slip in place. The visitors in desperate need of a breakthrough.
Length ball on middle and leg, de Kock looks to whip it through mid-wicket but ends up getting an inside edge onto his pads.
Back of a length ball which is kept out by de Kock standing tall.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Good length ball in the channel outside off, this time Bavuma offers a defensive shot.
FOUR! The outfield is lightning quick at Buffalo Park. Bavuma didn't hit that hard at all, just leaned into the shot and drove it through the gap in the covers.
Cutting back in off the surface as it's pitched on a length, tucked away on the leg side but for no run.
Fuller length delivery on middle and off, worked away with a closed face through the mid-wicket area for a couple of runs.
Fuller again, around off, met with a defensive bat in response.

FOUR! SHOT! That's a sensational shot. Full and outside off, Quinton de Kock crashes this through the covers to send it across the rope. Was there to be hit and he cashed it, wasn't going to miss out for anything.

An authoritative walk down the track from de Kock. Looks to slog it through the leg side but doesn't exactly middle it. Off the inner half but it's still hit hard. The man at mid-wicket does well to dive quickly low to his right and make the stop.
Back of a length on the stumps, kept out off the back foot with ease.

Pure timing from Temba Bavuma, but it's matched with an equally good fielding effort from Sabbir Rahman. Fuller ball outside off, Temba drives it sweetly through the covers. Sabbir runs after it hard and fast and manages to pull it back inside the rope. Lovely enthusiasm, saves a run for his side.
Keeps it tight, Mortaza. Bowls this length ball very close to the off stick. De Kock cuts it but finds short third man. Bavuma wants the run but is quickly sent back by his partner. Good call.
Wide! Fires it down the leg side, no shot offered by the batsman. The umpire raises his hands and signals a wide.
On a good length on the stumps, Bavuma with a comfortable flick through to deep mid-wicket for one more.
Quite straight in line, no trouble at all for the left-handed opener to work it behind square on the leg side for one.
Third man has gone a lot squarer, behind point effectively.
Moves inside the line of this length ball on off and nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
On the shorter side of things again, Bavuma with a back foot punch, finds the man at cover.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Temba stands his ground and pushes it to the man at extra cover.
Shortish in length and outside off, firmly punched to extra cover from within the crease to end the over.

FOUR! Lovely shot. Beautiful timing. Fullish in length outside off, Quinton de Kock just meets the ball with his straight bat. Doesn't hit it too hard, but it still beats the diving mid off fielder. Mashrafe Mortaza from mid on gives it a long chase and tries to pull it back just inside the rope with a dive, but fails in his attempt to do so. A boundary results!
Marginally ahead of a length, outside the line of off stump, hit once more to mid off.
Goes a little fuller again, de Kock with a big stride forward drives again, straight to the man at mid off this time.
Bit fuller this time, lands it on a length just outside off, de Kock plays this on the up as he drives it to covers. Couldn't pierce the gap, straight to the fielder.
Starts off with a back of a length delivery which is going across, de Kock rises and punches it square to point.
Bowling change. Rubel Hossain replaces Mehedi Hasan after just one over by the off spinner. He conceded 12 runs in that found it difficult to get his length right.
Finishes with a tidy delivery, but still 6 runs have come off it. Length ball on off, Bavuma with a relatively straight bat offers a punch down towards wide mid on.
Easily done. De Kock wrists this length ball through backward square leg and rotates strike.
Walks across to this shorter length ball and tucks it in front of square leg for a single.

FOUR! That's a brilliant shot from Temba Bavuma! Back of a length on off, he picks up the length early, dances down the track and pulls it aerially over mid-wicket to send it across the boundary line.
Short of a good length around the off stump, kept out well on the off side.
Good length ball on middle and off, Bavuma works it straight to the mid-wicket fielder.

FOUR! That's the third off the over, and it's come in the same area! This is good batting from Quinton de Kock! Like the previous two boundaries, de Kock rocks back and cuts it behind point for a boundary. 12 off the over, a big one for South Africa.
Stays back to this one which is pitched shorter in length, the left hander gets behind the line and guards it out.
Sliding in from around off, kept out from within the crease.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for de Kock! It's short, it's wide and there to be smacked away! Quinton de Kock waits for it and brings out the cut again past point. Picks up another boundary easily.
FOUR! That's bread and butter for Quinton de Kock! Mehedi drops it short and wide outside off from around the wicket, the southpaw hangs back and cuts it hard through point for a boundary.
Darted well outside off, punched off the back foot into the off side.
Spin straightaway! Mehedi Hasan will be bowling with the second new ball from the other end. A slip in place for him.
Fraction straight in line, Bavuma moves inside the line and tucks it to the mid-wicket fielder. Good first over for the Proteas, 6 runs off it.
On the fifth stump line, angling across the left hander, he cuts it late to third man and gets off the mark with a run.
Short and wide outside off, Quinton de Kock flays it but finds the man at cover-point. Quite unfortunate, made a sweet connection off the bat.
Outside off on a good length once more, Temba uses the swing away from his body to dab it down to third man for a single.
Better line this time. Length delivery closer to off with a hint of away movement, Bavuma confidently meets it with a straight blade.

FOUR! And Temba is away! Movement instantly and Mortaza bowls it wide outside off, Bavuma reaches out to it and cracks it between point and cover-point for a boundary. Went to bed last night and woke up today to get it going with a boundary. What better way to start the day!

We are set to get underway. It will be Temba Bavuma and Quinton de Kock to kick things off with the bat. Mashrafe Mortaza will take the first new ball for his team. Two slips in pace for him. Here we go...

Toss - South Africa win the toss and opt to bat! As expected, the hosts have a few changes in the team. Hashim Amla, JP Duminy and Dwaine Pretorius sit out for Aiden Markram (ODI debut), Temba Bavuma and Willem Mulder (International debut). For Bangladesh, they suffer a big blow with Tamim Iqbal out with a thigh injury. Soumya Sarkar replaces him. Also, Nasir Hossain is replaced by Mehedi Hasan.

We can talk as much about pride, honour, bouncing back and all those cliches in cricket but the reality remains that it's a David versus Goliath encounter and Davids win mostly only in books. As a cricket fan or enthusiast you can be hopeful of a good contest but somewhere deep down you know, it's a no match, especially after watching the last two games. Having said that, there is a famous quote - Hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things, and no good thing ever dies. Let us hope today, we get to witness one of those good things.
